biography_sections.title: Original evidence and remaining gaps
biography_sections.markdown:
### NRS Kilwaghter estate targets — 21 September 2026

The National Records of Scotland catalogue identifies exact, **Open, On site** primary targets: [GD154/514](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f514&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (tenant goods and livestock, c.1653), [GD154/515](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f515&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (rental, c.1653), [GD154/525](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f525&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (rentals, c.1690; two items), [GD154/530](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f530&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (rent-roll/accounts, November 1692; three items), and [GD154/532](https://catalogue.nrscotland.gov.uk/nrsonlinecatalogue/details.aspx?reference=GD154%2f532&st=1&tc=y&tl=n&tn=n&tp=n&k=&ko=a&r=GD154%2f5&ro=s&df=&dt=&di=y) (rent-roll/accounts, 1693–1708; eight items).

The public catalogue names no Glasgow and supplies no image or tenant transcription. Inspect the originals under `Kilwaghter`, `Kilwaughter`, `Kilwaugheter`, `Glasgow`, `Glascho`, `Glaskow`, and `Glassgow`. A tenancy may clarify the older South Side/Kilwaughter record groups, but it will not prove Robert’s parentage or children unless it names a relationship or succession.

biography_sections.title: Later Robert records do not bridge the early family
biography_sections.markdown: The manuscript-checked 1738 wife clause and 1741 farmer occurrence concern the later Robert-1143 household. They do not name a father or connect older Robert-1502 to any listed child. The next direct tests remain NRS GD154/514–515, /525, /530 and /532, PRONI T828/15 and MIC1B/6. Catalogue descriptions are targets, not Glasgow proof.
